title: tests/app_identity main.c includes lichen/coap_keys.h with no include path
description: lichen/tests/app_identity/src/main.c:13 includes <lichen/coap_keys.h>, but the test enables no LICHEN_COAP* Kconfig and its CMakeLists adds no coap include dir (only the coap subsystem's CMakeLists zephyr_include_directories exposes it). Found while verifying project-LICHEN-worker6-6fg3 on the AWS waves-base baseline: native_sim/native/64 build dies at compile with 'lichen/coap_keys.h: No such file or directory', so the image never reaches the link stage. main.c does not call any coap_keys_* function (include is vestigial) — remove the include or add CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_KEYS + the include dir. meshcore_gateway_adapter and meshtastic_ble main.c files are unaffected.
close_reason: Fixed on AWS waves-base, native_sim/native/64: (1) vestigial #include <lichen/coap_keys.h> removed from tests/app_identity/src/main.c AND subsys app_identity.c (decl for lichen_key_pubkey_to_iid now in link_ctx.h alongside lichen_identity_ygg_addr_from_ed25519; coap_keys.h decl kept). (2) Second-order IPV6=n link breakage fixed via option (a), 6fg3/hash32.c precedent: both small pure functions moved to new always-built lichen/subsys/lichen/link/identity_addr.c (registered in link/CMakeLists always-built block), definitions removed from coap/coap_keys_format.c and l2/ipv6_addr.c; no duplicate symbols when COAP_KEYS/IPV6=y. Verified: IPV6=n build EXIT 0 + ztest 6/6 PASS; EXTRA_CONF_FILE=ipv6_on.conf (.config confirms CONFIG_LICHEN_IPV6=y) build EXIT 0 + ztest 6/6 PASS. Host oracle run of identity_addr.c vs repo fixed SHA-512 vectors (key 0x11x32 -> iid 84 5b 92 0b da 4c d4 9d / ygg 02 84..9d) + NULL-arg -EINVAL checks: ORACLE PASS. Host tests/pubkey_to_iid ctest 100% (its CMakeLists now compiles identity_addr.c since it links ipv6_addr.c).
